sections.h2: The oil-gas price link broke after 2008 and did not return

chart.title: Correlation fell from +0.72 to −0.17 once the 2008 break hit
chart.sub: Pearson correlation, NYMEX daily spot prices, January 2006 to December 2014.

sections.means: The 2015 cointegration study found no long-run oil-gas relationship after the 2008 break, which it attributes to North American shale supply.
sections.todo: Until a liquid domestic gas hub exists, the ceiling is the only working decoupling lever.

sections.means: The notified $7.86 is well above the $2.64 Henry Hub spot price, a policy outcome rather than a market one.
